text: 8月19日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同智利外长佩雷斯举行会谈。王毅说，中智传统友谊源远流长，是隔洋相望的好朋友、好伙伴。智利是首个同新中国建交的南美国家，也是第一个同中国签署自由贸易协定的拉美国家，在发展对华关系上超越党派异同，始终走在拉美和加勒比国家前列。中智关系发展最重要的经验在于双方奉行独立自主外交政策，坚持相互尊重、平等相待，坚持优势互补、互利共赢。今年是中智建立全面战略伙伴关系10周年，中方愿同智新政府一道，赓续传统友谊，深化务实合作，推动中智关系迈上新台阶。
text_en: On August 19, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, held talks with Chilean Foreign Minister Alberto van Klaveren in Beijing. Wang Yi said that China-Chile traditional friendship has a long history, making them good friends and good partners across the ocean. Chile was the first South American country to establish diplomatic relations with New China and the first Latin American country to sign a free trade agreement with China, consistently leading Latin American and Caribbean countries in relations with China while transcending partisan differences. The most important experience of China-Chile relations lies in both sides pursuing independent foreign policies, adhering to mutual respect and equal treatment, and upholding complementary advantages and mutual benefit. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the China-Chile comprehensive strategic partnership. China is willing to work with Chile's new government to carry forward traditional friendship, deepen practical cooperation, and elevate bilateral relations to a new level.
